messages:
Mia: heads up, CI is red in eng-runtime on snapshot tests after bumping protobuf -> 3.20. Failing tests are under tests/serializers/ and look like serialization order changed.
ci-bot: [CI] Job failed: linux-python3.10 (run #512) — see logs: https://ci.example.com/builds/512 💥
Noah: can you paste the failing assert/diff?
Mia: here's the assertion block from pytest; the golden differs only in key ordering:
```
E       AssertionError: Snapshot mismatch
- expected: '{\"prompt\": [\"hello\", \"world\"], \"meta\": {\"lang\":\"en\"}}'
+ actual:   '{\"meta\": {\"lang\":\"en\"}, \"prompt\": [\"hello\", \"world\"]}'
```
Mia: I think a dict iteration order change in one of the serializer helpers caused this.
Ravi: ok - two quick checks: 1) can you run the exact test locally with -k and -q; 2) try PYTHONHASHSEED=0 to confirm ordering flakiness
Ravi: run:
```
PYTHONHASHSEED=0 pytest tests/serializers/test_prompt_serializer.py::test_snapshot_order -q
```
Mia: running now, will report back.
ci-bot: note: to rerun CI you can click 'Re-run failed jobs' in the workflow or use the API: curl -X POST -H 'Authorization: token $CI_TOKEN' https://ci.example.com/api/flows/512/retry
Priya: if local regen is legit we should update golden via `pytest --snapshot-update` but only after we confirm this isn't masking a bug. maybe add an assertion that compares sorted keys to avoid flakiness
Noah: also check if any dependency pinned `ruamel.yaml` or similar - YAML roundtrip can change maps
Mia: local run with PYTHONHASHSEED=0 passed, but without it fails intermittently — looks like nondeterministic ordering. I can push a deterministic sort patch if folks agree
Ravi: +1 to sort keys before serializing. quick patch idea:
```
def stable_serialize(obj):
    if isinstance(obj, dict):
        return '{' + ','.join(f'\"{k}\":{stable_serialize(obj[k])}' for k in sorted(obj)) + '}'
    # fallback to json.dumps for lists/primitives
    return json.dumps(obj, separators=(\',\',\':\'))
```
Noah: please open a tiny PR and tag @eng-runtime, ping me for review. add a test that sets PYTHONHASHSEED to random seeds to catch regressions.
Mia: created PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood-inference/pull/2142 — includes sorted-keys serializer + unit test. Triggering CI rerun now.
ci-bot: [CI] Re-run triggered: https://ci.example.com/builds/513 :thumbsup:
Priya: once CI is green we can merge. thanks for quick triage team :rocket:
Mia: thanks all, will follow up if anything else pops up.
